answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement of 0.879 and sequence agreement of 0.422 fall in the system-prompted ranges (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48), and are below the fine-tuned ranges (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64). TV of 0.130 and Token-DiFR gap of 0.455 also match system-prompted (0.108-0.144 and 0.28-0.52), while fine-tuned tops out at 0.099 TV and 0.31 gap. KL of 0.490 is higher than any category's range, but it is closest to system-prompted, the largest-change category. Quantized and base are ruled out because agreement is too low and the differences are non-zero. Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 4.2 is slightly above the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9) but within the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8), so fine-tuned is the main alternative.
